name: Medusa’s Stone

features.name: Medusa Spin
features.description: Turns character symbols on reels 2–4 into wilds.

features.name: Waiting wild multipliers
features.description: Bonus wilds stay until used, adding to a running total.

review:
Greek myth with a Medusa Spin that can randomly turn character symbols on reels 2 to 4 to stone wilds on any base-game spin.

Three bonus symbols give 10 free spins. In the bonus, Medusa's wilds carry 2x to 6x multipliers and stay until used in a win, when their multipliers join a running total for that and later wild wins. Super Bonus symbols during a Medusa Spin start 12 Super Free Spins. Up to 7,000x, 96.46% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
